specification.title: Relevant technique context is synthesized into cited claims
specification.description: Relevant ATT&CK context: the Research Agent receives the technique chunk and must persist a claim that cites exactly the supplied technique citation.
specification.purpose: Verify the Research Agent persists a claim that cites exactly the supplied technique citation when relevant context is retrieved.
specification.operational_relevance: Claim-level citation grounding is what makes RAG output reviewable and safe.
specification.regression_risk: The agent could omit the required claim, cite the wrong citation, or drop the required phrase.

required: At least one claim is persisted
Every claim cites only supplied citations
A claim contains the required phrase about obscuring command-and-control traffic
forbidden: A claim cites a citation that was not supplied

query: obfuscate command-and-control traffic conceal exfiltrated data
